$comment: Prosary editorial translations of calendar display-title metadata from Evangelizo SYE, not liturgical prayer texts and not official church editions. Original English identities, including source typos, are exact lookup keys; displayed names correct obvious source spelling errors. Existing sourced Hebrew entries are retained and remain credited in the canonical Hebrew title catalogs. Other labels and numbered-day templates are authored interface translations. Calendar dates, rite, ranks, readings and precedence are unchanged. Pentecost is rendered in Hebrew as שבועות at the user's request.
